**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Lucy](../persons.html#2116)
If I can get a lift I shall be very glad to come to you, but it must rather depend on the ‘other house.’ Does [George](../persons.html#1611) know that we have the [Bishop Selwyn](../persons.html#1296), his [mother](../persons.html#1297), children and [new wife](../persons.html#1685) at the Vicarage for a month? [^1]
Your affectionate cousin

C M Yonge

[^1]: The Rt.

Rev.

John Richardson Selwyn (1844-1898), who became Bishop of Melanesia in 1877 and retired to England finally in September 1891.

This letter may date however from his previous visit to England in June 1889-January 1890.

He had married his second wife Annie Catherine (Mort) Selwyn in 1885.
